name: Lee Braithwaite
bio: Lee can currently be seen in WE LIVE IN TIME which premiered at last year's LFF. He was also seen in COWBOIS at the RSC and also the London transfer to the Royal Court and at the National Theatre in THE OTHER PLACE.

credits.title: Peter
credits.overview: A trans man caring for his father with alcohol-induced dementia finds unexpected reconnection when the disease grants him temporary anonymity.

credits.title: We Live in Time
credits.overview: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.
